summary.text: Yes. Your Trusted Contact may live outside Singapore if they meet the eligibility criteria.

details.heading: Eligibility requirements
details.body: Your Trusted Contact must be a CPF member aged 21 and above, a Singapore Citizen or Singapore Permanent Resident with a Singpass account, and have both a Singapore-registered mobile number and email address registered with CPF Board.

example_phrasings: Can I appoint a Trusted Contact who is not based in Singapore?
Can my Trusted Contact live overseas?
Can I choose someone who lives outside Singapore?

sources.page_title: Can I appoint a Trusted Contact who is not based in Singapore?

quotes.text: You may appoint a person who is not based in Singapore as your Trusted Contact as long as they meet the eligibility criteria.

Your Trusted Contact must: be a CPF member aged 21 and above; be a Singapore Citizen or Singapore Permanent Resident (with Singpass account); and have both a Singapore-registered mobile number and email address registered with CPF Board
